summary_en: Targets and metrics not disclosed in press release header. Full policy details deferred to attached material (2026 Jun update). Board reviewed and updated management approach to capital-cost awareness and share-price alignment.
title_en: Response to the Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief: On 18 June 2026, Kyushu Leasing Service held a board meeting to review and update its approach to realizing management conscious of capital cost and share price. The press release announces that the board conducted current-state analysis and evaluation, and updated its policy direction for future improvements. Specific target metrics, payout-ratio floors, and performance horizons are deferred to the attached detailed material (titled "Response to the Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price (June 2026 Update)"). The disclosure is classified as a COC_UPDATE (Cost of Capital policy revision) under the company's governance framework.
